data.name: Heeraya
data.gender_notes: Heeraya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Urdu word 'heera' meaning 'jewel'. Heeraya signifies a delicate and graceful being, one who is precious and valuable. The name Heeraya carries the meaning “Delicate, Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Heeraya usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle touch of Allah in one's life.
data.etymology: Heeraya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heeraya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
